macro.summary: We are operating in a risk-off defensive regime as volatility spikes and breadth deteriorates significantly. We will scale back our core equity long exposure, favoring defensive sectors like consumer staples and utilities while deploying tactical shorts and mean-reversion plays. Keep a close eye on retail sales and upcoming jobless claims for macro direction.
